hooks.name: Run matching checker test on save
hooks.description: When a file in checker/src/checks/ is saved, run its tests: checks/<name>.py runs tests/test_<name>.py if it exists (e.g. p2_sentence_length.py runs tests/test_p2_sentence_length.py), otherwise the full checker suite. The saved path comes from the hook event JSON on stdin.

action.command: cd checker && uv run python scripts/run_matching_test.py
